name: manual_608576
claim: RED-first discipline: write the failing test and capture its failure output BEFORE implementing; the captured RED evidence (collection error or assertion output) belongs in the board completion notes and PR body, not just the final green count

decisions.notes: The outbound-ledger lane captured the collection-error RED state before implementing; reviewers and the board could verify the tests actually failed first — cheap, high-trust evidence.

rationale: The outbound-ledger lane captured the collection-error RED state before implementing; reviewers and the board could verify the tests actually failed first — cheap, high-trust evidence.
